notes: The primary evidence is the official Yamaha EU owner's manual for the 2018-2020 MT-07 (B4C-28199-E2), which is the MY2020 generation. Israeli-market bikes are assumed EU-spec; no Israeli importer schedule was found. The secondary sources (MaintenanceSchedule.com, MotoVault) are derived from Yamaha manuals and are NOT independent evidence. The official chart is a tick-mark table: intervals for engine oil, oil filter, spark plugs, brake inspection and coolant inspection were read from tick positions on rendered pages, and the locators give the ticked columns. Annual-check rule per the TIP: annual checks every year unless a distance-based maintenance is performed instead, which is the basis for engine oil at 10000 km or 12 months. A severe-use note has no number: the air filter 'needs to be replaced more frequently when riding in unusually wet or dusty areas' (p.6-8). No fuel filter or timing chain interval was found.
